samples.summary: Clear formatting no longer strips `href`, so an unvalidated (possibly hostile-scheme) URL that entered via paste now persists through the one bulk-scrub users had
samples.evidence: `href` is removed from `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` (types.ts:300-315). Hrefs enter the document unvalidated: `view/clipboard.ts:612` and `:714` copy `` straight off pasted HTML with no `isSafeUrl` check, and `text-box-editor.ts:1195/1230` stores whatever `insertLink` is handed. Attack shape: attacker crafts HTML with `visit your bank`, victim pastes it into a doc/text box; previously selecting the text and pressing Clear formatting removed the href, now it survives and can only be removed via `removeLink` (docs: link popover, slides: the new button). I could not turn this into an exploit — every navigation/export sink I enumerated gates the scheme (`text-editor.ts:1822`, `:2176`, `docs-link-popover.tsx:217/224`, `serialize/markdown.ts:248`, `export/pdf-painter.ts:853`, `slides/src/export/pptx/text.ts:333`), so the stored hostile URL is inert today. The residual risk is that the persistence of unvalidated hrefs in the CRDT now depends entirely on every current and future sink remembering the gate. Validating (or at least scheme-filtering) hrefs on the paste path would make this defense-in-depth rather than gate-only.
searchedFor: read slides pptx import/export href handling

samples.summary: An `href` on an empty-text run is now removable by no command at all — `removeLink` refuses zero-length runs and Clear formatting no longer clears `href`
samples.evidence: The new doc comment itself states the case (caret-style.ts:61-69): `normalizeInlines` leaves an empty inline carrying the deleted link's `href`, `findLinkRunAt` refuses a zero-length run so `removeLink` cannot reach it, and the lessons doc (docs/tasks/active/20260908-docs-clear-formatting-keeps-links-lessons.md) says outright that "Clear formatting used to be the one escape from that residue". After this change a URL an attacker got into the document (paste path, clipboard.ts:612) can sit in the model with no user-reachable command that deletes it, and it is re-attached to text on the paths that seed from the caret style. `isAtLinkTrailingEdge` mitigates the typed-character case for the guarded seeds, but the stored value itself is unremovable and rides along in exports/CRDT sync. Not exploitable on its own — the residue paints nothing and the export gates still filter hostile schemes — so this is a data-hygiene/weakened-mitigation note rather than a vulnerability. The root fix named in the lessons doc (dropping `href` in `normalizeInlines`' all-empty fallback) is explicitly deferred.
